tools.name: notebooks
tools.description: List the user's Google NotebookLM notebooks. Requires sign-in in Extensions settings. Read-only.

tools.name: upload
tools.description: Upload original text from an Anx book to NotebookLM, only when the user asks. scope=chapter uploads the currently open chapter/page; scope=book uploads the complete EPUB, including spoilers. bookId selects a library EPUB. PDF supports only the currently open page/chapter, not full-book upload yet. Creates a notebook unless notebookId is supplied. Returned sources may still be processing.

operationId.description: Stable unique operation ID. Reuse on retry; never change it to bypass an uncertain previous attempt.

notebookId.description: Notebook ID returned by notebooks or upload. Never invent it.

tools.name: ask
tools.description: Ask Google NotebookLM a question grounded in a chosen notebook. Returns final answer and source IDs for citation numbers. Each question is independent; include needed follow-up context.

notebookId.description: Notebook ID returned by notebooks or upload. Never invent it.

tools.name: audio
tools.description: Generate a NotebookLM audio overview ONLY on explicit user request. Uses the user's Google generation quota. Returns a job/artifact ID; poll status later. Never automatically retry an uncertain creation.

operationId.description: Stable unique operation ID. Reuse on retry; never change it to bypass an uncertain previous attempt.

notebookId.description: Notebook ID returned by notebooks or upload. Never invent it.

tools.name: status
tools.description: Check existing NotebookLM Studio artifacts and audio readiness. Read-only; use before retrying any uncertain generation.

notebookId.description: Notebook ID returned by notebooks or upload. Never invent it.

tools.name: download
tools.description: Download an existing completed audio overview to the phone. Obtain artifactId from status. Does not generate new audio.

notebookId.description: Notebook ID returned by notebooks or upload. Never invent it.
